templates.title: One agent
templates.summary: A lead agent that plans, does and verifies the work.
templates.goal: Complete the project and verify the result.

personas.name: lead
personas.role: Plans the work, does it, verifies it and reports the result.

templates.title: Lead and reviewer
templates.summary: A lead does the work; a reviewer checks it before it counts as done.
templates.goal: Complete the project and have every result reviewed.

personas.name: lead
personas.role: Plans and does the work, then asks the reviewer to check each result.

personas.name: reviewer
personas.role: Reviews each result the lead hands over, and approves it or lists what to fix.

templates.title: Lead and three workers
templates.summary: A lead splits the work into tasks; three workers claim and finish them.
templates.goal: Split the project into tasks, finish every task and verify the result.

personas.name: lead
personas.role: Splits the work into tasks, assigns them, checks finished tasks and reports progress.

personas.name: worker-1
personas.role: Claims a task, finishes it with evidence and reports to the lead.

personas.name: worker-2
personas.role: Claims a task, finishes it with evidence and reports to the lead.

personas.name: worker-3
personas.role: Claims a task, finishes it with evidence and reports to the lead.
